title: mcfcg: column generation for minimum-cost multicommodity flow
description:
A column generation solver for the minimum-cost multicommodity flow problem, supporting both path-based and tree-based Dantzig-Wolfe decompositions over a shared CG loop.

This archive is the computational artifact accompanying “Tree-based formulation for the multi-commodity flow problem” (arXiv:2509.24656). It contains the solver, four LP backends (HiGHS, MOSEK, COPT, NVIDIA cuOpt) behind one interface, every benchmark instance of all four families, the instance-preparation and benchmark scripts, and the committed result tables under results/.

PROVENANCE.txt pins the exact solver versions, host and patches behind those tables, and states which results are reproducible with open-source components only. The default build is HiGHS-only and needs no licence and no GPU.
